mapper.select: /* com.kt.openapi.web.guide.dao.GuideDAO.selGuideShubList */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT Row_number() OVER(ORDER BY A.AMD_DT DESC) rownum, A.API_SPC_NO, A.API_SPC_ID, A.VER, A.API_NM, A.API_DESC, COALESCE(A.AMDR,'') AS AMDR, COALESCE(( SELECT MBR_NM FROM koa_tb_mbr B WHERE A.AMDR = B.MBR_ID ),'') AS AMDR_NM, A.AMD_DT, TO_CHAR(A.AMD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AMD_DT_FMT, TO_CHAR(A.AMD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as AMD_DT_STR, A.REG_STTUS_CD, COALESCE(D.CD_NM,'') AS REG_STTUS_CD_NM, A.SYS_ID, COALESCE(S.SYS_NM,'') AS SYS_ID_NM, B.API_NM AS API_DEF_NM, B.API_DESC AS API_DEF_DESC, B.METHOD_CD, B.API_NO, COALESCE(C.CD_NM,'') AS METHOD_NM FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC A INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF B ON (A.API_SPC_NO = B.API_SPC_NO) LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD D ON (A.REG_STTUS_CD = D.COMN_CD AND D.GROUP_CD = 'APIREG1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD C ON (B.METHOD_CD = C.COMN_CD AND C.GROUP_CD = 'MTHTYP1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM S ON (S.SYS_ID = A.SYS_ID) WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.REG_STTUS_CD = 'APIREG1030' AND A.SYS_ID = 'SHUB' ) A /* [현대화] MS SQL Server 표준 OFFSET/FETCH 적용 */ ORDER BY A.rownum ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 6 ROWS ONLY
